details: The US economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter of 2026, with an annualized rate of 4.3%. Simultaneously, inflation continued to accelerate in October, with the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index rising to 3.8% year-over-year, and core PCE inflation, excluding food and energy, increasing to 3.3% annually. This data strengthens market expectations for a quarter-percentage-point interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December, a scenario that typically puts downward pressure on risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin and other digital assets have already shown sensitivity to these rate expectations.
title: US Inflation Accelerates, Reinforcing Fed Rate Hike Expectations

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released a policy paper in November 2026, indicating a significant shift in global finance towards central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) and digital financial assets. The IMF notes that 146 countries are exploring digital currencies, with a growing emphasis on wholesale CBDCs for improved cross-border payments and interbank settlements. While acknowledging potential benefits, the IMF also warns that the tokenization of financial markets could amplify financial risks, potentially accelerating the speed at which stress events unfold and leaving less time for intervention.
title: IMF Highlights Global Shift Towards Digital Currencies and Tokenization Risks

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is actively advancing its comprehensive payments strategy, including the development of a digital euro. In a November 2026 speech, the ECB reiterated its commitment to ensuring central bank money remains fit for the future amidst the digitalization of payments and tokenization of finance. The ECB is conducting a new wave of activities through its digital euro innovation platform, with a pilot phase for a digital euro expected in 2027 and potential issuance around 2029, pending legislative approval. This initiative aims to provide a trusted public foundation for digital payments and foster innovation while strengthening Europe's financial autonomy.
title: ECB Advances Digital Euro Pilot, Focusing on Resilience and Innovation

details: Asian stock markets experienced a downturn on November 25, 2026, driven by fresh US tariff threats and a faltering rally in artificial intelligence (AI) related stocks. This "risk-off" sentiment extended to cryptocurrencies, with Bitcoin and Ether prices also seeing drops. The broader market reaction reflects investor caution amid geopolitical uncertainties and a reassessment of growth-oriented assets, indicating that traditional market sentiment continues to influence the crypto space.
title: Asian Stocks Tumble as AI Rally Stumbles Amid US Tariff Threats
